Directory research 2026-10-04: Not a local band: 'Go Punk Yourself' is a touring branded pop-punk night whose band members are not named. No official website was found; a Linktree 'gopunkyourselfofficial' (likely the show's Instagram hub) appears in search but Linktree blocks automated checks, so no Instagram is recorded - candidate for the owner to check: linktr.ee/gopunkyourselfofficial. Do NOT confuse with the unrelated 'Go Punk Yourself' punk radio show on 98KUPD in Arizona (facebook.com/gopunkyourselfradioshow). The owner may prefer to treat this as an event, not a performer profile.
description: A touring pop-punk tribute night: a live band plays 2000s pop-punk hits by bands like Blink-182, Fall Out Boy and Sum 41. The show visits clubs in several cities, including Mulcahy's in Wantagh, Gramercy Theatre in Manhattan, Philadelphia and the Chicago area.

evidence.note: Mulcahy's (Wantagh) lists 'Go Punk Yourself - A Night of Pop Punk Classics' on Nov 13, 18+, with a live band playing Blink-182, Fall Out Boy, Sum 41 and more.
The same branded show played Gramercy Theatre in Manhattan on Aug 15, 2026.
Same show with identical wording booked in Philadelphia on Nov 20, 2026, so this is a touring production rather than a Long Island band.
